2) For HIPAA scope: are you asking for Business Associate Agreement (BAA) language up-front, or will a SOC 2 controls mapping and encryption details suffice to start?

Thanks — I’ll start filling the questions we already covered and label anything that needs follow-up.

2) What are your default log retention windows for API access logs and audit logs? Can these be configured longer per-customer?

4) Where are backups stored and what is the typical backup retention?

We’re targeting a security review by next Friday 6/25. If possible please send the pre-filled SIG and any supporting artifacts (SOC 2 report, encryption whitepaper) by EOD Wed 6/23.

Hi Leslie — thanks for the clear asks. Below are short answers to your numbered items; I’ve also attached a pre-filled SIG spreadsheet with references where available.

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II for our Hosted API covering the control categories listed in the attached SOC controls mapping. Our latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering Jan–Dec 2026) is available under NDA — I’ve noted this in the spreadsheet and attached a controls summary. If you need the full report we can start an NDA and share via our secure portal.

2) Log retention: default API request logs and application audit logs are retained 90 days by default. For enterprise customers we offer configurable retention up to 3 years via our Dedicated/Private options; for Hosted we can extend retention to 1 year for customers on an enterprise plan (requires contract amendment). I noted these fields in the SIG.

3) Encryption / KMS: Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. For Hosted customers we manage keys using a provider-managed KMS, and we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. We can discuss a BYOK workflow if you need customer-controlled HSM/KMS.

4) Backups: Backups are stored in encrypted object storage in the same region (us-east-1) with a default retention of 30 days for application data snapshots and 90 days for metadata snapshots. We can provide extended backup retention for enterprise contracts; noted in the SIG.

Point of contact for technical follow-ups: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai), Director of Security Programs. She’s cc’d here and can join a call if your GRC team wants a technical walkthrough.

Attached: filled_SIG_acme_v1.2.xlsx, Redwood_Inference_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC_controls_summary.pdf

I’ll also add short inline notes in the SIG where I’ve put links to the controls mapping and where an NDA is required. Let me know if you want me to schedule a 30-min Q&A with Marissa Thursday morning.

Best,
Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
